idiom_name: pydantic v2 discriminated union validated straight into the canonical model
implementation_notes: pydantic v2 makes the router part of the type system: declare one model per source format with a Literal tag (type: Literal["csv"]), then Annotated[Union[CsvIn, XmlIn, LegacyIn], Field(discriminator="type")] causes exactly one member to be selected from the discriminator and validated, so model_validate routes and translates in one call and the generated JSON Schema documents the seam; a callable Discriminator(...) covers sources whose tag must be derived from several fields. What replaces the classic structure is that discriminated union plus validation - no translator registry and no hand-written guards - while functools.singledispatch or a dict of pure functions remains the lighter and often better choice when the input is already parsed, non-JSON (CSV rows, fixed width) or needs collaborators that a stateless validator should not own.
code_sketch:
from typing import Annotated, Literal, Union
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, TypeAdapter
class CsvOrder(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["csv"]
    raw: str
class XmlOrder(BaseModel):
    type: Literal["xml"]
    document: str
Wire = Annotated[Union[CsvOrder, XmlOrder], Field(discriminator="type")]
wire = TypeAdapter(Wire).validate_python(payload)   # router = discriminator, one member
canonical = to_canonical(wire)                      # consumers see one shape
pitfalls: An untagged Union (smart or left_to_right mode) guesses a member by validation order and yields wrong-but-valid results when two formats overlap; the discriminator is the only predictable mode.
extra='ignore' is the default and silently drops unknown source fields: use extra='forbid' or log the extras on the canonical model so a partner's format change surfaces.
pydantic coercion is generous (str to int, naive datetimes): pass strict=True on the canonical model and give money and ids a Decimal or str type rather than float.
ValidationError is the error channel of the whole seam, so catch it per message and route to the invalid-message channel instead of letting one partner stall the pipeline.
